mapper.select: SELECT qna_num, qna_category, qna_name, qna_title, qna_content, TO_CHAR(qna_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS qna_date, qna_readcnt FROM pet_qna_board ORDER by qna_num DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_qna_board (qna_category, qna_name, qna_title, qna_content, qna_pwd) VALUES(#{qnaCategory},#{qnaName},#{qnaTitle},#{qnaContent},#{qnaPassword})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_qna_board SET qna_readcnt = qna_readcnt + 1 WHERE qna_num = #{qnaNumber}
